title: Ordinary scalar extension commutes with element-site restriction
statement: Let (C,J), A,R,S,a and ET,EV be the sectionwise scalar-extension models of [def-pur-topos-open-scalar-section-data]. There is a natural isomorphism rho:E_T L_S ≅ L_R E_V. At every element-site object (U,f), it sends the local pure tensor m tensor s to the same tensor in the scalar extension of the restricted module. This holds for every sheaf A, without subterminality or a flatness assumption.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 04IE; scalar-extension specialization, using continuous cocontinuous precomposition.

proof.text: The continuous cocontinuous element projection commutes with sheafification of additive presheaves. Lift its compatibility through the module sheafification Hom equivalence. On the scalar-extension presheaf, restriction is definitionally the corresponding scalar-extension presheaf on the element site. Transport the resulting sheafification isomorphism by ET.obj_eq and EV.obj_eq.

The defining sheafification Hom equivalence says the compatibility map takes each sheafification-unit tensor to the same tensor. Its generator formula proves naturality after scalar-adjunction transposition: maps out of scalar extension are determined on tensors m tensor 1. Taking the inverse gives rho in the stated direction and its pure-tensor formula.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03EL and 04IE; element-site sheafification and unit-generator characterization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_toposOpenScalarRestriction
    (ET : DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel.{u, u, u, w, w} a)
    (EV : DerivedChangeOfRingsCochainModel.{u, u, u, w, w} (sliceMap A a)) :
    ∃ rho : ET.E ⋙ restriction S A ≅ restriction R A ⋙ EV.E,
      ∀ (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} (derivedChangeRingIndependentCoefficients J R))
        (U : Cᵒᵖ) (f : A.obj.obj U) (m : M.val.obj U) (t : S.obj.obj U),
        (rho.hom.app M).val.app (elementObj A U f) (tensorSection a ET M U m t) =
          tensorSection (sliceMap A a) EV ((restriction R A).obj M)
            (elementObj A U f) m t
